notes.title: [CHANGELOG 3/29/2012]
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

After spending some much needed time tracking all issues reported, we found a very plausible cause for the white screen on launch along with some performance issues and other minor bugs we could fix. Hopefully you won't be experiencing any problems launching the game from now on.
We would like to thank everybody who took their time helping us improve the game with their reports and comments on the forums and send a special thanks to "jsmucha" for his thorough report about bugged achievements.

[CHANGELOG 3/29/2012]

- Fixed multithreaded loading issues. This was the main cause for the white screen when launching the game many users reported.
- Fixed default resolution issue where the game would take Windows reported resolution instead of the real desktop resolution resulting in some impossible to render scenarios.
- Fixed FPS drops under certain circumstances.
- Fixed several achievements reported by the community.
- Fixed bullets not colliding while on a multiplayer game.
- Fixed map objects colliding after dying.
- Added security measures to game scripts.
- IMPROVED OVERALL EXPERIENCE
Once again thanks again to everyone for helping out!

notes.title: [CHANGELOG 12/21/2011]
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. It has been some crazy few days for Bunch of Heroes with a ton of new players trying the game. Thanks a lot to all of you!
Due to popular demand, we have limited the re-spawning time for players, so those of you hunting for achievements will have an easier time. For those who enjoy a harder game, the insane difficulty mode is still a blast.
The update is in Steam's capable hands, so it should be up in no time.

Here's the list of changes:

[CHANGELOG 12/21/2011]
Gameplay:
- Re-spawn time has been limited to 1 minute. 
-  Added Survival and Time attack leaderboards
Fixes:
- New Safe Mode launch option. Launch the game with "-safe" to force the game into launching in 1024x768.
- Several fixes including a crash with Santa and a piece of dialog

notes.title: [CHANGELOG 12/15/2011]
notes.notes:
Hello Bunch of players! We have a new update for you just in time for the holidays with yet another challenging mode, timed survival!

And speaking about challenges, we have listened to your suggestions and have added new difficulty settings to the game, making it even more challenging for those who think they can brave it. There's also an easy mode for newcomers. 

[CHANGELOG 12/15/2011]
Gameplay:
- New Mode: [Timed Survival Mode] Destroy as many enemies as you can in 5 minutes of pure mayhem!
- Difficulty Settings: Choose from Easy, Normal, Hard and Insane

Networking:
- Updated: [Lobby] The lobby now shows expanded info on each game including mode and difficulty.

DLC
- Updated: [New DLC] Look for our Holyday pack DLC! Ho, ho, ho!

Happy holidays everyone!

notes.title: New Release - Bunch of Heroes
notes.notes:
Bunch of Heroes is now available on Steam and is 10% off until September 28th at 10AM Pacific Time!

This Bunch is the most formidable team of elite fighters ever assembled. Jump in to the co-op action with up to 4 players and save Earth from nasty aliens and undead hordes!
